grammar_title: 主谓一致(2):分数/百分比 of 短语 · 不定代词 · 就近原则与 there be
source: 外研社选择性必修第三册 Unit 4 Using Language:Subject-verb agreement (2)。句子地道、人工智能主题;每题只一个数(单/复)正确,其余为错误的数或非谓语形式,答案唯一。解析不引用选项字母。

points.point: 分数/百分比/most/half/part/the rest of + of 短语
points.overview: 分数、百分比、most/half/part/the rest of 等 + of + 名词作主语时,谓语与 of 后面的名词保持一致:of 后是不可数名词或单数→用单数;of 后是复数名词→用复数。

points.point: 不定代词 + many a / more than one / the number of
points.overview: each/every/either/neither/one(of)/everyone/everything/someone/nobody/none(正式)作主语→单数;both/all(+复数)→复数,all/none(+不可数)→单数;many a + 单数名词、more than one + 单数名词、the number of→单数;a number of→复数。

points.point: 就近原则(either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also)与 there be
points.overview: either…or、neither…nor、not only…but also 连接并列主语时,谓语与最近的那个主语保持一致;there be 句型的谓语与紧跟其后的第一个名词保持一致。

questions.stem: Almost 50 per cent of US jobs ____ at risk from automation in the next 20 years.
questions.explanation: 百分比 of 后是复数名词 jobs,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Fifty per cent of my time ____ spent looking for restaurants before I got an AI assistant.
questions.explanation: of 后是不可数名词 time,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: Two-thirds of the information ____ now stored safely in the cloud.
questions.explanation: 分数 of 后是不可数名词 information,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Three quarters of the surface ____ made up of land in their design for the new planet.
questions.explanation: of 后是单数名词 surface,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Forty per cent of the robots in the factory ____ controlled by a single program.
questions.explanation: of 后是复数名词 robots,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: The rest of the workers ____ worried about losing their jobs to machines.
questions.explanation: the rest of 后是复数名词 workers,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: The rest of the report ____ written by an AI in just a few seconds.
questions.explanation: the rest of 后是单数名词 report,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: A third of the students ____ already using AI tools to do their homework.
questions.explanation: 分数 of 后是复数名词 students,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Half of the news we read today ____ produced with the help of technology.
questions.explanation: half of 后是不可数名词 news,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Half of the journalists ____ afraid that machines will replace them.
questions.explanation: half of 后是复数名词 journalists,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Twenty per cent of the energy ____ saved by the building's smart system.
questions.explanation: 百分比 of 后是不可数名词 energy,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Most of the world's problems ____ too complex for one expert to solve alone.
questions.explanation: most of 后是复数名词 problems,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Most of the software on this phone ____ updated automatically overnight.
questions.explanation: most of 后是不可数名词 software,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Part of the danger ____ that AI may act without any human control.
questions.explanation: part of 后是不可数名词 danger,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Sixty per cent of the questions ____ answered correctly by the chatbot.
questions.explanation: 百分比 of 后是复数名词 questions,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Three fifths of the building ____ run by automatic systems.
questions.explanation: 分数 of 后是单数名词 building,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: A large proportion of taxi drivers ____ likely to lose their jobs to AI.
questions.explanation: proportion of 后是复数名词 drivers,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: Nearly 90 per cent of the work ____ done by robots on this production line.
questions.explanation: 百分比 of 后是不可数名词 work,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: The majority of scientists ____ that AI must be carefully regulated.
questions.explanation: the majority of 后是复数名词 scientists,谓语用复数 believe。

questions.stem: Two-thirds of the city's traffic ____ now guided by AI.
questions.explanation: 分数 of 后是不可数名词 traffic,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Each of the new robots ____ able to make simple decisions on its own.
questions.explanation: each of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Every recommendation the assistant gives me ____ surprisingly useful.
questions.explanation: every + 单数主语 recommendation,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: None of us ____ fully prepared for the challenges that AI will bring.
questions.explanation: none of us 作主语,正式用法看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Neither of the two programs ____ able to feel real emotion.
questions.explanation: neither of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Everyone in the research lab ____ excited about the new breakthrough.
questions.explanation: everyone 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Everything the machine learns ____ stored for future use.
questions.explanation: everything 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Each of the children ____ given a report showing their possible talents.
questions.explanation: each of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: More than one expert ____ warned us about the dangers of AI.
questions.explanation: more than one + 单数名词作主语,谓语用单数 has。

questions.stem: Many a student ____ dreamed of building a machine that can think.
questions.explanation: many a + 单数名词作主语,谓语用单数 has。

questions.stem: Both of the engineers ____ working hard on the self-driving car.
questions.explanation: both of 作主语表复数,谓语用 are。

questions.stem: All of the data ____ kept safe on the company's own servers.
questions.explanation: all + 不可数名词 data,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: All of the workers ____ been trained to use the new system.
questions.explanation: all + 复数名词 workers,谓语用复数 have。

questions.stem: One of the testing companies ____ the talents of twins on its website.
questions.explanation: 主语是 one(of 短语作定语),看作单数,谓语用 compares。

questions.stem: Someone ____ left a robot dog at the rocket station.
questions.explanation: someone 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 has。

questions.stem: A number of clients ____ been attracted to genetic testing for children.
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数名词作主语表复数,谓语用 have。

questions.stem: The number of jobs at risk ____ rising every single year.
questions.explanation: the number of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Either of the answers ____ acceptable to the judges of the contest.
questions.explanation: either of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Nobody on the design team ____ sure what the AI will do next.
questions.explanation: nobody 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Each robot and each program ____ tested carefully before it is sold.
questions.explanation: each…and each… 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Neither of the scientists ____ willing to ignore the risks of AI.
questions.explanation: neither of 作主语,看作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Either the manager or the workers ____ going to test the new robot today.
questions.explanation: either…or 连接主语,谓语与最近的 workers 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Neither the workers nor the manager ____ ready for such a big change.
questions.explanation: neither…nor 连接主语,谓语与最近的 manager 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Not only the students but also the teacher ____ using AI tools now.
questions.explanation: not only…but also 连接主语,谓语与最近的 teacher 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Not only the teacher but also the students ____ using AI tools now.
questions.explanation: not only…but also 连接主语,谓语与最近的 students 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: There ____ a few machine-learning problems when the first cars reach the market.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的 problems 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: There ____ a real danger that such powerful AI could be misused.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的 danger 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Either the robot or the cars ____ able to learn from new data.
questions.explanation: either…or 连接主语,谓语与最近的 cars 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Neither the cars nor the robot ____ able to feel tired or bored.
questions.explanation: neither…nor 连接主语,谓语与最近的 robot 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: There ____ many taxi drivers who could lose their jobs to AI.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的 drivers 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Not only the journalists but also the editor ____ being replaced by software.
questions.explanation: not only…but also 连接主语,谓语与最近的 editor 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Either you or your friend ____ to decide whether to trust the AI.
questions.explanation: either…or 连接主语,谓语与最近的 your friend 一致,用单数 has。

questions.stem: Neither the engineers nor the designer ____ to blame for the error.
questions.explanation: neither…nor 连接主语,谓语与最近的 designer 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: There ____ an assistant and several apps built into my new phone.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的第一个名词 an assistant 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: There ____ several apps and one assistant built into my new phone.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的第一个名词 several apps 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Not only the company but also its clients ____ worried about privacy.
questions.explanation: not only…but also 连接主语,谓语与最近的 clients 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Either the program or the robots ____ making the final choice.
questions.explanation: either…or 连接主语,谓语与最近的 robots 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: Neither the robots nor the program ____ truly alive in any real sense.
questions.explanation: neither…nor 连接主语,谓语与最近的 program 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Not only the driver but also the passengers ____ protected by the safety system.
questions.explanation: not only…but also 连接主语,谓语与最近的 passengers 一致,用复数 are。

questions.stem: There ____ no easy answer to the question of how to keep AI safe.
questions.explanation: there be 与紧跟其后的 answer 一致,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Either the scientists or the government ____ going to set the new rules.
questions.explanation: either…or 连接主语,谓语与最近的 government 一致,用单数 is。
